description: Leb Ganda giloko kwede ki dano milion mapol i Buganda, i dye Uganda, i Kampala ki ka ma orumo.
notes: Drafted by Claude (AI) for the Acholi courses (#130) with low confidence in Acholi; needs a native-speaker review. Word and unit notes fall back to the English notes about the target language.

why.title: Leb me **yo me Kampala.**
why.text: Leb Ganda giloko kwede ki dano milion mapol i dye Uganda, dok en aye leb ma giloko loyo i Kampala. Pwonye me loko ki dog gang, nongo lurem i cuk, ki winyo calo itye gang i wot ni.

cards.title: Pi dog gang
cards.text: Lok ki kwaro ki pwony lutino leb man.

cards.title: Pi luwot
cards.text: Mot dano, dwok wel piny ki wot labongo lworo.

cards.title: Pi jo ma mito ngeyo
cards.text: Nong kaka me Buganda ki carolok gi.

sample.prompt: Lok mene ma tyen lok ne “apwoyo”?

landing.audience: Jo ma loko Leb Acoli ma gicako manyen, dog gang ma mito loko ki watgi i Buganda, ki luwot ma gicito i dye Uganda.
landing.first: Moto, tito nyingi ki kwan wel, lacen dog gang, cam, cuk, cawa, kabedo, gang ki yot kom, dul ki dul.

cast.emma: Welo ma tye ka pwonye Leb Ganda ma peya owoto
